calibration.shieldFace: away from the arm (her left side)

note: bakeMatrix maps shield GLB vertex positions (liora-shield-mobile.glb, root space) into Liora skin bind space for a rigid 100% weight on the forearm joint. Derived in a real Babylon 9.33.2 scene: world shield frame built from the Idle_02 forearm->hand axis, then expressed in the forearm joint frame and multiplied by the joint's bind matrix.
